ruleDefinitions.name: T1486 — Ransomware File Rename (.lockbit) (Fact #21)
ruleDefinitions.description: Ransomware File Rename (.lockbit). Trigger: explorer.exe renames files to a known ransomware extension
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: '{process_name}' changed the creation time of {file_name} to a known ransomware extension (Sysmon rule: FileCreateTime — its proxy for file rename)
ruleDefinitions.suppressScope: JoinIfExists(EntityId('type: User && direction: Source'), EntityId('type: Device && direction: Source'))
